title: The lost umbrella
instructions: Bir kadın kafede unuttuğu şemsiyesini soruyor. Şemsiyenin tarifine ve nerede olduğuna dikkat et.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Excuse me. I was here this morning, and I think I left my umbrella.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: At the table next to the window.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: Let me look. Is this it?

script.speaker: woman
script.text: No, that one is black. Mine is green.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: Oh, wait. There is a green one behind the door.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Yes, that's my umbrella! Thank you so much.

questions.prompt: When was the woman at the café?
What does her umbrella look like?
questions.feedback: Şemsiyesi yeşil, üzerinde beyaz çiçekler var.

questions.evidence: At the table next to the window.

questions.feedback: Siyah olan onun değil; yeşil şemsiye kapının arkasında.
questions.evidence: There is a green one behind the door.
